build_subword_encoder: build a SubwordTextEncoder from a corpus generator with a target vocabulary size
create_encoder_from_list: create a SubwordTextEncoder from a pre-built vocabulary list of subword strings
encode_text_to_ids: encode a text string into a list of integer subword ids
decode_ids_to_text: decode a list of integer ids back into the original text string
save_encoder_to_file: save a SubwordTextEncoder vocabulary to a file for later loading
